# Security Policy

OpenCleanup is a build-time Maven plugin. Please report vulnerabilities
privately so maintainers can investigate and prepare a fix before details are
made public.

## Supported versions

| Version line | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| 1.2.x | Yes |
| Older versions | No |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please use [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/lhozdroid/opencleanup/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue for a suspected security vulnerability.

If the private reporting form is unavailable, contact [@lhozdroid](https://github.com/lhozdroid)
privately through GitHub with the subject `OpenCleanup security report`.

Include the affected version, a clear description of the impact, reproduction
steps or a proof of concept, and any suggested mitigation. You can remove or
redact credentials and other sensitive data from the report.

We will acknowledge valid reports, keep the report private while a fix is being
prepared, and coordinate public disclosure with the reporter when appropriate.
